schema_version: v0 — skill-charter shape; migrates into the intention envelope when MAP.md Q6 lands
what: The chaining skill over the chart device's question nexi: run the pre-build preamble as explicit, schema-gated stages. v0 carries ONE stage — orient (floor first, curtain held, the ceiling's mini agentic loop, the gate, the instance-space berth). Each later stage's prompt is TEMPLATE-FILLED from the previous stage's validated file as its nexus lands — a skipped stage is a build error, not a lapse.
why: Akien's skill-door facts (2026-07-28): CC skips steps when the answer looks visible; plain instructions get executed directly rather than routed through a skill; but /skillname fires reliably. So the preamble lives behind the slash-door — the one invocation path with physics rather than discipline behind it. The emitted packet is the inspectable artifact ('so we can inspect and improve what you're getting'); the schema gate at each handoff is the append-door pattern (Law 4). Device charter: cairn/chart/intention+why.json; ticket: CairnCommons/tickets/chart-orient.json.
state: v0 — first cast 2026-07-28, one stage (orient). Grows a stage per landed nexus; /moreabout is the sibling learning door (its own stone).

nexus.note: SKILL.md carries the live sequence; this is the charter-face record.
nexus.routes_forward: orient packet berthed -> (later stages template-fill from it) -> the BUILD PACKET

how_it_learns: Through the device's three mechanisms (deposit-back, /moreabout signals, the per-nexus dial) — the skill itself holds no state; it is the ceiling's vehicle. Its own learning surface: gate refusals during real use are gate-records for the nexus's exit schema (a field the ceiling repeatedly can't fill honestly is a schema defect, not a discipline defect).
